title: Press sole onto shoe
contact_roles: the left hand holds the sole and the shoe together, thumb on the heel's upper and fingers on the sole. At about 3 s, as the sole goes onto the shoe, what it holds is named as the shoe instead (one "hold moves to" event); the grip itself doesn't change until the shoe is rolled at about 3.2–3.7 s. There the Fingers plot drops to about one finger: the fingers still on the sole sit 2–3 cm off it in the 3D fit, just outside the touch distance.
